title: Influence of a formula enriched with resistant starch for exclusive enteral nutrition in children with acute Crohn's disease on selected butyrate-producing bacteria of the intestinal microbiome and inflammation
summary: In a study with children and adolescents aged 6 to 18 years who have been diagnosed with an acute attack of Crohn's disease, the aim is to investigate whether drinking nutrition enriched with resistant starch helps with treatment and supports remission. It will also be investigated whether the microbiome changes as a result of the resistant starch and its degradation products.

interventions.name: Interventiongroup, ecxclusive enteral nutrition with formula with resistant starch with the duration of 8 weeks
Interventiongroup, ecxclusive enteral nutrition with formula without resistant starch with the duration of 8 weeks

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of Crohn's disease according to Porto criteria
Acute relapse (PCDAI > 30)
Luminal disease
Use of an immunosuppressant (azathioprine or methotrexate)
informed consent from the patient and legal guardians
Exclusion criteria:
Remission (PCDAI < 11)
Ileus, perforations, tumours, fistulas
Perianal disease
Bacterial / viral infections
Pregnancy
Medication with glucocorticoids, antibiotics, TNF-α antibodies, tacrolimus or cyclosporine
Known intolerance to the components of the formula
Participation in other intervention studies
